title: Nortani Raat (Garba)
label: Kirtidan Gadhvi
description: A 14-track 2025 album by Kirtidan Gadhvi and Anita Pandit; the split edition is the canonical song release, while the separately published 33:10 continuous master remains a distinct Nonstop representation and is not used to infer 14 YouTube chapter starts.
notes: Amazon Music publishes a 14-track split edition credited to Kirtidan Gadhvi and Anita Pandit. The displayed durations sum to 33:10. Amazon and Kirtidan Gadhvi Official also publish a separate one-track 33:10 continuous master. The split album is the canonical song edition; the continuous master remains a distinct Nonstop listening representation and is not used to infer 14 YouTube chapter starts.
